prompt: A wood screw holds tightly and advances slowly as you turn it many times. A screw is best understood as which simple machine in disguise?

options.text: A lever bent into a circle
An inclined plane wrapped around a cylinder

explanation: The thread of a screw is a ramp — an inclined plane — spiralling around a central cylinder, trading many turns for a strong forward force.
